summary: Cognex filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, announcing an agreement to acquire RealSense, Inc., a depth-sensing camera and robotic-perception vision company, in an all-cash transaction valued at $500 million subject to customary adjustments. Funding comes entirely from existing cash and investments; closing is expected in Q4 2026 subject to customary conditions. Cognex also plans roughly $45-55 million in RSUs and up to $69 million in cash retention over three years, with acceleration for certain key employees on qualifying terminations. Watch integration execution, retention-driven expense, and any regulatory or closing delays.
